## Why visit

A strong choice for drinkers who care about a cellar’s consistency. Wirral CAMRA awarded this comfortable former shop its cellarmanship prize in 2022, 2023 and 2025. The rotating cask programme deliberately covers bitter, pale and a dark porter or stout rather than offering only the most popular style. It is worthwhile if a Wirral excursion passes through Bromborough, especially combined with the nearby Hop, but not a reason to skip Liverpool’s central historic classics on a first visit.

## Beer

Four changing cask ales, usually covering pale, IPA, bitter and dark beer.

## Plan the visit

CAMRA’s February 2026 listing says daily afternoon/evening opening and warns of limited accessibility at the entrance and toilets.

**Getting there:** About a ten-minute walk from Bromborough Rake station, or local bus to Bromborough centre.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
